review_candidates.title: Network Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Description Network Administrator Redwire Corporation is a global Space and Defense technology Company building the infrastructure of the future and delivering multi-domain solutions. Responsibilities Plan, implement, and administer network infrastructure. Perform Layer 3 (L3) troubleshooting and diagnose network issues. Maintain cloud and hybrid network connectivity. Organize and maintain network documentation, standards, and procedures. Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Sci
eligibility_evidence: Maintain cloud and hybrid network connectivity.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Telecommunications, or related field (or equivalent experience). At least 2 years of hands-on experience in networking/infrastructure, including implementation, troubleshooting, and maintenance. This may include verification of identity, employment history, qualifications, and the provision of a criminal record statement.
